create_impala_config: create an IMPALAConfig instance with default settings for the IMPALA reinforcement learning agent
configure_impala_optimizer: configure the IMPALA optimizer by setting batch_size, learning_rate, and adam decay parameters
configure_impala_loss: configure the IMPALA loss function by setting baseline_cost, entropy_cost, and max_abs_reward
configure_impala_replay: configure the IMPALA replay buffer by setting samples_per_insert, max_queue_size, and replay table name
validate_impala_config: validate an IMPALAConfig instance to ensure max_queue_size is larger than batch_size plus one
